0022600117.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (3-0, 2-0 at home, 1st in the Atlantic, 3rd in the East, on a three-game win streak) host the Detroit Pistons (2-0, 1-0 on the road, 1st in the Central, 2nd in the East, on a two-game win streak), with both teams unbeaten so far. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), LeBron James (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Jabari Walker is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while Detroit is missing Jalen Duren (hamstring, strain) and Ausar Thompson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the 76ers lost all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
